        gate_results = compute_visual_gate(dino_dir, scene_groups)
        for scene, info in gate_results.items():
            status = "PASS" if info["pass_gate"] else "FAIL"
            print(f"  {scene}: mean_cos={info['mean_cosine_similarity']:.4f} [{status}]")

        gate_path = os.path.join(args.output_dir, "visual_gate.json")
        with open(gate_path, "w") as f:
            json.dump(gate_results, f, indent=2)
        print(f"  Saved: {gate_path}")

    # Layer sweep
    if is_dino:
        layers = [0]
    else:
        layers = parse_layers(args.layers, args.num_layers)

    feature_dim = 1024 if is_dino else args.feature_dim
    all_results = {}

    for layer in layers:
        layer_key = "dino" if is_dino else layer
        print(f"\n--- Layer {layer_key} ---")

        layer_results = {}
        for scene, tasks in scene_groups.items():
            n_classes = len(tasks)
            t0 = time.time()

            X_tr, y_tr, X_val, y_val = prepare_data(
                args.feature_dir, tasks, layer, args.aggregation, is_dino,
                args.seed)

            probe_dim = feature_dim
            pca_info = None
            if args.pca_dim is not None:
                X_tr, X_val, pca_info = apply_pca(X_tr, X_val, args.pca_dim)
                probe_dim = args.pca_dim

            if len(X_val) == 0:
                print(f"  {scene}: SKIP (no val data)")
                continue

            met = train_goal_probe(
                X_tr, y_tr, X_val, y_val, probe_dim, n_classes, args, device)
            met["scene"] = scene
            met["tasks"] = tasks
            met["n_classes"] = n_classes
            if pca_info:
                met["pca_info"] = pca_info

            layer_results[scene] = met
            print(f"  {scene} ({n_classes}-way): acc={met['accuracy']:.4f}  "
                  f"ep={met['epochs_trained']}  {time.time()-t0:.1f}s")

        accs = [v["accuracy"] for v in layer_results.values()]
        mean_acc = float(np.mean(accs)) if accs else 0.0

        all_results[str(layer_key)] = dict(
            per_scene=layer_results,
            mean_accuracy=mean_acc,
            layer=layer_key,
        )
        print(f"  Mean accuracy: {mean_acc:.4f}")

    # Summary
    print("\n=== Summary ===")
    if all_results:
        best_layer = max(all_results, key=lambda k: all_results[k]["mean_accuracy"])
        print(f"Best layer: {best_layer} "
              f"(acc={all_results[best_layer]['mean_accuracy']:.4f})")
        for lk in sorted(all_results,
                         key=lambda x: (x != "dino", int(x) if x != "dino" else -1)):
            print(f"  Layer {lk}: {all_results[lk]['mean_accuracy']:.4f}")
    else:
        best_layer = None
        print("No results.")

    # Save
    results_out = dict(
        model_type=args.model_type,
        n_scene_groups=len(scene_groups),
        scene_groups={s: t for s, t in scene_groups.items()},
        best_layer=best_layer,
        best_accuracy=all_results[best_layer]["mean_accuracy"] if best_layer else None,
        per_layer=all_results,
    )

    results_path = os.path.join(args.output_dir, "results.json")
    with open(results_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results_out, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nSaved to {args.output_dir}/")
